card.name: Dose amounts and units in dosing text
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces inside dose statements, such as the unit mg after a strength, a digit within a dose like 100 mg, or a word like in or concentration after a drug name. It appears in dosing instructions and dose tables.

modes.label: Units and digits in doses
modes.description: The unit or a digit piece inside a stated dose amount.

modes.label: Linking words after drug or quantity nouns
modes.description: A small word or noun right after a drug name or amount, in a sentence about the amount.
modes.example: the amount of carbidopa<< in>> carbidopa-levodopa should

card.writes: Weak and mixed; the promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words about changing or modifying, so there is no clear effect on dosing text.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers and units inside dose amounts, and on words that follow a drug name in a dosing sentence.
